scientific_integrity: An analytic dimension proof is supplied; finite exact checks are supplementary rather than exhaustive, and independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns strict infinite directional itineraries of the logistic map at parameter four, with infinitely many decreases and a convergent decrease frequency. It excludes observational noise, other logistic parameters, and frequency-irregular words. Prior tent-map symbol coarse-graining is credited; complete text of Pfante et al. (2013/2014) was inaccessible and historical priority remains provisional.
title: Frequency-resolved Hausdorff ambiguity of full logistic directional itineraries
